reports.label: Tuesday, 3 November 2026
reports.headline: Nasdaq -1.07%, Brent settles $104.77; GIFT Nifty +93 vs close, Kospi -2.47%
points: Nifty closed Monday at 23,440.80 (+1.68%). GIFT Nifty was 23,533.50 at 7:24 AM IST, 92.70 points above it (one source).
US close Monday: Dow +0.41%, S&P 500 -0.51%, Nasdaq -1.07%. VIX rose 8.91% to 21.15.
Brent settled at $104.77 (-7.63%) and WTI at $96.46 (-7.36%). Reuters linked it to US-Iran peace hopes.
Asia early Tuesday: Kospi -2.47%, Shanghai -1.18%, Hang Seng -0.09% (one live source). Japan is closed for Culture Day.
Today: Nifty weekly expiry; SBI, Bajaj Finserv, Lupin and MCX Q2 results; US midterm elections; AMD reports after the US close.
